global.title: Directional wave and sea surface temperature measurements collected in situ by Datawell Waverider buoys located near IMPERIAL BEACH NEARSHORE, CA from 2006/12/19 to 2026/05/03.
global.summary: Directional wave and sea surface temperature measurements collected in situ by Datawell Waverider buoys located near IMPERIAL BEACH NEARSHORE, CA from 2006/12/19 to 2026/05/03. This dataset includes publicly-released data only, excluding all records flagged bad by quality control procedures. A total of 174947 wave samples were analyzed for this area, where the water depth is approximately 18 to 21 meters.
